card.text: Young giant planet about 34 au from PDS 70, with a dusty disc of its own seen by ALMA.

sources.label: Benisty et al. 2021
sources.quote: Our observations confirm the presence of a compact source of emission co-located with PDS70c

introduction.text: PDS 70 c is a gas giant still forming about 34 au from its star, taking about 200 years to orbit. ALMA sees dust around it, a disc of its own.

sources.label: Benisty et al. 2021
sources.quote: Our observations confirm the presence of a compact source of emission co-located with PDS70c

sources.label: Trevascus et al. 2025
sources.quote: The presence of two directly imaged planets, PDS 70 b and c, in the PDS 70 protoplanetary disk provides us a unique opportunity for dynamical mass measurements

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
